blocks.text: Following receiving critical acclaim at the 2026 Cinemalaya Independent Film Festival for her dramatic role in “2 Valid IDs,” Pokwang is relishing her “drama actress” era, with a hope to work with the likes of Sharon Cuneta and Maricel Soriano. During a chat with entertainment reporters where she bared that “2 Valid IDs” will now be up for theatrical release begining October 14, Pokwang said she is happy that the movie where she was able to showcase her serious acting chops was offered to her.
